circuit_support.definition: Declared mechanism has a supported circuit under supplied TX/RX configuration; not a decoder or activity event.

snr2500.definition: Wanted received signal/noise at receiver connector in equivalent 2500 Hz noise bandwidth, conditional on a characterized transmission and listening exposure.

network_detection.definition: Detection in the existing model version-specific cell/time/exposure population; requires that exact model event contract, never a personal path probability.

observed_activity.definition: Qualified reports within an explicit time interval and observed source coverage; absent reports do not label a failed propagation event.

conditional_decode.definition: Declared decoder/version meets its criterion within observation duration given transmission, listening and known configuration.

completed_qso.definition: Completed two-way exchange within a declared attempted recommendation/session under an explicit completion protocol; unknown outcome retained.

field_strength.definition: Field amplitude at declared location, polarization, height and measurement bandwidth/support.

usable_burst.definition: At least one burst meeting a registered duration/spread/decoder criterion in an exposed interval; not a completed exchange.

pass_geometry.definition: AOS/LOS timing error for declared horizon, ephemeris, time/frame and target; not transponder availability.

doppler.definition: Frequency shift under declared transmitted frequency and signed range-rate convention.

measurement.estimand: Mean absolute error over independently sampled characterized transmission/listening exposures with observed SNR irrespective of decoder outcome, within each preregistered band/domain/horizon population.
measurement.weights: Within each row: equal weight per directed TX/RX station pair, then equal weight per eligible exposure within that pair. No pooling across rows or inverse-probability weights in v0.1.
measurement.population_status: BLOCKED: sampling frame and eligible station-characterized SNR corpus not established
measurement.censored_policy: Known failed detection without measured SNR retains upper/lower bound and exposure for a separately preregistered censored estimand; excluded from ordinary SNR MAE without pretending the full population was evaluated.
measurement.unknown_policy: Retain missing/unknown reasons and denominators; never label unknown as failure or zero SNR.
measurement.missing_predictions: Paired comparison uses identical eligible rows; report attempted-domain availability separately. Qualification blocked until an abstention/missing-prediction rule is frozen; no selective easier-case skill claim.
measurement.skill: 1 - candidate weighted MAE / comparator weighted MAE on identical pairs and fixed weights; comparator MAE=0 makes relative skill undefined, not a pass.
measurement.pass_rule: Target >=0.20 legacy relative MAE reduction and positive paired 95% interval lower bound; any external superiority claim additionally requires external paired skill lower bound >0. All prerequisite gates must pass in a future reviewed protocol.

coverage.require: Block uncertainty and interval score/sharpness vs baseline, by adequately powered row

measurement.regression: Reject a preregistered powered slice with >10% MAE degradation supported by its paired 95% interval; Holm correction for confirmatory slice claims. Insufficient slices cannot pass.

replay.times: UTC; observed interval end <= issuedAt; publishedAt and capturedAt <= issuedAt. Forecast issue/publication/capture <= issuedAt while validAt may be future.
replay.revisions: Immutable source versions with SHA-256; no later revised product replacing an earlier issued context.
replay.pairing: Same directed TX/RX, event, mode, frequency, issue/valid time, inputs and dataset row ID for candidate and comparator; differences disclosed as separate experiment.
replay.isolation: Freeze disjoint development/validation/independent station/date/storm manifests before fitting; independent stations absent from fit, holdout dates buffered by frozen leakage window, entire storm events assigned once; prospective predictions archived before labels.
replay.split_assignment: BLOCKED: dataset hashes, station IDs, date ranges, storm definitions and leakage buffers not yet available; no sealed N5 access or repurposing

resampling.blocks: Build an exposure graph connecting observations sharing either TX or RX station identity, UTC date, or declared storm event ID. Connected components are independent candidate resampling units; component definitions frozen before outcomes.
resampling.weights: Draw components uniformly with replacement, retain full paired exposures and recompute fixed pair/exposure weighting with bootstrap multiplicities.
resampling.insufficient: If connectivity leaves fewer than 30 independent components or power/precision fails, BLOCKED; never split a storm/station across resampling units to pass.
resampling.status: BLOCKED: candidate feasibility, storm boundaries and power await development-only study; ordinary receiver networks may form one giant component. Not a generally qualified multiway estimator; other events require separate protocols.

G-FAMILY must select/pin applicable strong comparator; no universal all-band comparator

runtime_profiles.workload: 24 instantaneous hourly samples x existing 11 catalog slots; 160m and 6m eligibility separate, P533 parity only 2–30MHz

runtime_profiles.prerequisite: G-RUNTIME; family mesh/modes/assets/cancellation budgets not frozen
G-RUNTIME; seconds-scale sampling and interval aggregation/error budget not frozen
